error.SECRET_REFERENCE_PROJECT_LAYER: The project config (.deckent/config.json) may not use a secret reference; only the installation config may name an installation secret. Move the reference to the installation config or remove it.
error.SECRET_REFERENCE_LEAVES_HOST: This value leaves the machine (for example the delivery commit author), so it may not come from a secret reference in any config. Write the plain value.
error.AUTHORITY_WITNESS_REQUIRED: Changing authority (the permission mode, a secret, the secret store, MCP server trust, the policy template upgrade, trusting a worker instruction file or installing an execution environment such as Docker Engine) needs a person at an interactive terminal: run the command in a real terminal on this host, with input and output on the same terminal. AI tools, MCP, SDK scripts and piped commands cannot make this change, even with --yes. Nothing was changed.
error.MCP_TRUST_NEEDS_CARD: The MCP server {name} was trusted where Deckent no longer reads trust (the project's data folder). Approve it once on its card: run `deckent mcp approve {name}` in a terminal without --yes, or use it in the terminal and answer its card. Nothing was changed.
security.mcp.note.project: project file: only these environment variables are read: {names}; any other reads as its default or empty, and a value carrying a credential refuses the server; secret references are refused
security.mcp.note.moved: a trust record for this server in the project's data folder is no longer used; decide again on this card
security.witness.config: The setting {key} is protected: only a person at their own interactive terminal may change it. Run the same deckent command (for a setting also the terminal's /config) in your own terminal on this host, with input and output on the same terminal. AI tools, MCP, SDK scripts, CI, piped commands and --json cannot change it. Nothing was changed.
